async def act(page):
    # Click on 'Reviews and Ratings' to expand or navigate
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Reviews and Ratings").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # After clicking, wait a bit for any submenu or page load
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    # Now click on 'Customer Reviews' to go to the reviews management page
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Customer Reviews").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # On the reviews page, search for 'decent'
    # Look for a textbox to input search term, using a more specific selector
    search_box = page.get_by_role("textbox").first
    await search_box.fill("decent")
    # Find and click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").first
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Count the number of reviews in the table
    review_table = page.get_by_role("table").first
    rowgroup = review_table.get_by_role("rowgroup")
    rows = rowgroup.get_by_role("row")
    count = await rows.count()
    # Adjust for header row if present
    if count > 0:
        count -= 1
    # Return the count as a string
    return str(count)
